title: Book Three · Chapter 109: The Paper Box
story:
On Monday, Ronan takes the two damaged books and the large old card to Mr Qiu.

Leo has agreed. Mr Qiu has seen the missing pages and knows the books are incomplete.

He opens the paper box beneath his stall.

“Here.”

Ronan puts both books inside. The old sale card goes beside them. No money changes hands.

The two books leave the shared stock as waste paper. They will not go onto a story table again.

Mr Qiu takes one whole page and folds it around a small bundle of pencils. He turns the printed side inward.

Ronan holds the pencils while he ties the string.

“A little tighter,” Mr Qiu says.

Ronan moves his thumb. The pencils stay together as the string goes round them.

Mr Qiu sets the packet near his other stock. Ronan puts the remaining paper flat in the box.

The shared sale has no books, bags, or cash left now. Five good books, one bag, and twenty and a half yuan belong to each boy. Leo's share is safe with his grandmother.

Ronan goes to school with only his own books in his bag.

At lunch, Kai asks about the folded card.

“Gone,” Ronan says.

“No more giant letters?”

“Only the teacher's.”

Kai looks at the board. A very long word is waiting there.

“Those cost more.”

Ronan laughs and opens his lunch. Anna comes back from Lin's desk. She sits beside him and asks about a question from the morning lesson.

They look at it together for a few minutes. She explains one part. He finds the line she needs on the next page.

At the bell, both put the right mark beside it. Neither has done the other's whole page.

After school, Ronan finishes his seventeenth letter to Leo. He copies the grandmother's signed count and tells him about the paper box.

He adds a question about Leo's new desk and his view of the board. At the end, he writes that he still enjoyed the first sale morning with him.

Ronan buys the stamp with his own money. The former shared cash is already divided. Postage does not change either share.

On the walk home, he passes the empty place beside the pencil stall. Mr Qiu has left the doorway clear. A customer carries a wide basket through it without a turn.

Ronan waits for her to pass, then goes into the yard.

His five books are on his own shelf. He takes one down, looks at the first page, and sits near the window to read before dinner.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

inward＝向里；packet＝小包；former＝原先的；postage＝邮费。

## 理解问题

1. 两本问题书和旧价牌实际交给了谁、用作什么？有没有收到钱或当完整故事再卖？
2. 第十七封信的邮费有没有从已经分好的共同份额中扣除？

## 读句子

**No money changes hands.**

拆开看：No money / changes hands.

没有钱／在这次交接中转手。
